ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background comprising approximately 75-80% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters providing localized high contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density mottling of light-colored, contiguous circular and sub-circular blobs distributed across the distal and medial regions of both lobes. The proximal region near the peduncle junction is a solid, low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile along the entire trailing boundary. Irregular peak-to-valley pixel distances with prominent jagged protrusions at the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-curved trailing edges that terminate in slightly hooked, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) scattered across the ventral surface, consistent with the density of barnacle-related colonization marks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, partially occluded by high-intensity mottling.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged edge topography at the distal tips suggesting previous mechanical trauma or significant wear; dense concentration of high-contrast spotting across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rim lighting/specular highlight along the superior edges of the fluke lobes due to low-angle backlighting from the background light source.
